One of the best co-op games I've ever played. Great balance, atmosphere and community. An ideal option to distract from work or study - no rage, just chill and having fun. It catches on from the first hours of the game. I recommend it to everyone. There is only one small drawback. Lack of new content, especially missions. You can feel it when you've been playing for more than 100 hours. Although I realize that the reason is the limited capabilities of a small team of developers who do not have enough financial and human resources. However, the game has a serious potential for growth, and I would like to see this potential in practice before the DRG becomes obsolete.

There are so many things to like about this game. It's a fun horde shooter with procedural cave generation and various missions to play. It really scratches that left4dead2 itch, with a lot of progression bells and whistles such as different classes, weapons, and overclocks to to earn and play with. Each of the 4 classes plays uniquely and compliments each other well.

On top of that, the game's monetization is unlike any other game with a season format as well. So much free content has been added to the game in the form of items, guns, battle passes, enemies, events, and more. All of this without any FOMO: all content stays earn-able forever.

Lastly, what truly sets this game apart is how Ghost Ship Games, through they way they've designed their game, have created a community of the most friendly coop players I've ever experienced in a shooter. Through my almost 275 hours of playing this game, I know I can hop in and blast hordes of bugs without having to worry about any toxicity whatsoever if I make a mistake. There is so much camaraderie and in-jokes, and veteran dwarves helping and being patient with new miners. I've encountered more instances than I can count where players have gone out of their way to be kind and true team players in this game than any other. 

Can't recommend this game enough. Rock and Stone!

Deep Rock Galactic is a great time if you have friends and are willing to put in a few hours grinding for gear. Once you've gotten your first few levels and understand the mechanics of the game, it is an absolute blast. Worth it at any sale price for sure, but even full price is honestly worth it for this modern classic.

Deep Rock Galactic is a great co-op experience. You get to choose your own difficulty, but it is really fun how quickly things can go chaotic at higher hazard levels. With randomly generated levels and several different mission types, the gameplay never gets old.
When you first start up, a couple of things are locked behind your first prestige/promotion, but that's more to help you get acquainted with the basics of the game before showing you everything.
If you don't have that many friends, the game is still plenty fun by yourself.
DRG is plenty fun and you should play it. ROCK AND STONE!
